SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS schedulingWorkorder, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS productionWorkorder, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeWorkorder FROM mes_product_workorder

WITH date_range AS ( SELECT DATE(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq.seq DAY)) AS date FROM (SELECT 0 AS seq UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6) seq ) SELECT dr.date, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 2 THEN '周一' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 3 THEN '周二' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 4 THEN '周三' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 5 THEN '周四' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 6 THEN '周五' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 7 THEN '周六' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(dr.date) = 1 THEN '周日' END AS week, -- 星期名称 COUNT(DISTINCT p1.id) AS schedulingNum, -- 排产数量 COUNT(DISTINCT p2.id) AS completedNum -- 完工数量 FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN mes_product_workorder p1 ON DATE(p1.create_time) = dr.date -- 排产数量：create_time 在当天 LEFT JOIN mes_product_workorder p2 ON DATE(p2.update_time) = dr.date -- 完工数量：update_time 在当天 AND p2.status = 3 -- 状态为完工 GROUP BY dr.date ORDER BY dr.date
